title: pvExtractSurface
body:
## pvExtractSurface

Extracts the outer surface of any dataset as polygonal data (vtkGeometryFilter): boundary faces of 3-D cells plus all lower-dimensional cells, with point and cell arrays carried over and internal faces removed. It is the same native filter as the curated surface operation, which has no options; choose pvExtractSurface to control nonlinear-face subdivision, fast mode, ghost-interface removal or piece invariance. For interfaces between materials use pvExtractRegionSurface.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- FastMode may miss faces, for example on blanked structured data; keep it off when the surface is measured or exported.
- The outer surface of a CFD domain includes inlets, outlets and far-field boundaries, not only walls; extract the patches you need (extractBlock) when a specific boundary matters.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractSurface`. Identity: `filters/DataSetSurfaceFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Extract Surface filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FastMode` | When enabled, the filter may use approxiamte algorithm for extracting the exterior surface at the risk not being highly accurate. This may miss interior faces, for example, for structured data with blanking for better speed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `NonlinearSubdivisionLevel` | If the input is an unstructured grid with nonlinear faces, this parameter determines how many times the face is subdivided into linear faces. If 0, the output is the equivalent of its linear counterpart (and the midpoints determining the nonlinear interpolation are discarded). If 1, the nonlinear face is triangulated based on the midpoints. If greater than 1, the triangulated pieces are recursively subdivided to reach the desired subdivision. Setting the value to greater than 1 may cause some point data to not be passed even if no quadratic faces exist. This option has no effect if the input is not an unstructured grid. | `{"maximum":4,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `PieceInvariant` | If the value of this property is set to 1, internal surfaces along process boundaries will be removed. NOTE: Enabling this option might cause multiple executions of the data source because more information is needed to remove internal surfaces. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `RemoveGhostInterfaces` | Set whether Ghost interfaces will be removed. When you are rendering you want to remove ghost interfaces. There are certain algorithms though that need the ghost interfaces. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvExtractSurface",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
